intro_zh: 本課學習 There is / There are 的用法，說明某處有單數或複數的動物或物品。透過農場、樹林、池塘等情境，讓學生練習描述周圍有什麼。
can_do: 能說出農場裡有什麼動物。
能用 There is / There are 描述圖片中的動物。
能正確區分單數與複數的情況選擇 is 或 are。

sentences.en: There are six ducks and a goose near the pond.
sentences.zh: 池塘邊有六隻鴨和一隻鵝。

sentences.en: There is a cow on the farm.
There is a goat and a pig beside the barn.
sentences.zh: 谷倉旁有一隻山羊和一隻豬。

sentences.en: There is a hen beside the coop, and there are two horses in the field.
sentences.zh: 雞舍旁有一隻母雞，田裡有兩匹馬。

sentences.en: There is a sheep under the tree, and there is a dog near the fence.
sentences.zh: 樹下有一隻綿羊，籬笆旁有一隻狗。

sentences.en: There is a rabbit in the garden, and there is a turtle beside the rock.
sentences.zh: 花園裡有一隻兔子，岩石旁有一隻烏龜。

sentences.en: There is a fish in the water, and there is a frog on the leaf.
sentences.zh: 水裡有一條魚，葉子上有一隻青蛙。

sentences.en: There is a koala and a panda in the tree, and there is a deer near the house.
sentences.zh: 樹上有一隻無尾熊和一隻貓熊，房子旁有一隻鹿。

sentences.en: There is an elephant and a kangaroo beside river, and there is a mouse near house.
sentences.zh: 河邊有一頭大象和一隻袋鼠，房子旁有一隻老鼠。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① There is / There are 與單複數名詞的對應
grammar_points.explain_zh: There is 用於單數名詞，There are 用於複數名詞，說明某處有什麼。
table: There is a cow on the farm.
There is a cow on the farm.

grammar_points.title_zh: ② There is a… 與 It is a… 的差別
grammar_points.explain_zh: There is a… 用來說明某地點有什麼東西；It is a… 用來說明某物是什麼。

examples.en: There is a koala in the tree.
There is a pig in the pen.

lines.en: Look! There is a cow on the farm.
There are six ducks near the pond.
There is a goat beside the barn.
There are two horses in the field.
There is a turtle under the tree.

sentences.en: There is a dog in the house.
There are three hens on the farm.
There is a fish in the bowl.
There are many frogs near the pond.
There is a deer in the forest.
There are two mice under the cabinet.
There is a panda near the bamboo.
There are five kangaroos in the field.

grammar: 用 There is 接單數名詞、There are 接複數名詞，說明某處有什麼。

mcq.q: There ___ a goat on the farm. (農場裡有一隻山羊)

opts: There is a sheep on the farm.
There is sheep on the farm.
There are sheep on the farm.
There are a sheep on the farm.
mcq.ans: There is a sheep on the farm.

mcq.q: There ___ two ducks on the farm. (提示：複數)
There ___ three horses on the farm. (提示：複數)
圖片顯示農場裡只有三隻兔子。哪句正確？
opts: There are three rabbits on the farm.
There are a rabbit on the farm.
There is a rabbit on the farm.
There is three rabbits on the farm.
mcq.ans: There are three rabbits on the farm.

fill.q: There ____ a dog on the farm.（農場上有一隻狗）
There ____ three cows on the farm.（農場上有三頭牛）
We ____ cows on the farm.（我們在農場上看到牛）
The duck ____ under the cow.（鴨子在牛下面）
The goat ____ to the farm.（山羊去農場）

translate.ans: We see cows on the farm.
The duck is under the cow.
The goat goes to the farm.
